head: 2f1ee510dabc29a2cdb9b5081a47d4a0decedc03
checks: trust domains: --check-config refuses the Sui device key as aws_iot.private_key_file; the separate AWS thing certificate/key configuration verifies

Mosquitto mosquitto version 2.0.20 mutual TLS (client identity = certificate CN, ACL file, CRL): component -> cloud under dt/thing1/ and cloud -> component at QoS 1; an ACL-denied publication is dropped by the broker (MQTT 3.1.1 PUBACK) and never delivered; the ACL-denied subscription cmd/other/# receives nothing (Mosquitto grants it at SUBACK for MQTT 3.1.1)
Mosquitto outage: 5 publications spooled on disk while the broker was stopped, delivered in order after reconnect

Mosquitto rotation: a half-installed set (new key, old certificate) is reported and ignored while the old connection continues; the complete set reconnects with the new certificate (RSA -> P-256); with the old certificate revoked by CRL and the broker restarted, traffic continues on the new identity
Mosquitto revoked identity: rotating to the CRL-revoked certificate is refused by the broker and reported; the publication waits in the spool and is delivered once valid credentials are installed
untrusted endpoint: a server certificate from another CA is refused (TLS handshake with iot.test.local failed: invalid peer certificate: UnknownIssuer)
port 443: ALPN x-amzn-mqtt-ca negotiated by default, client id = thing name, thing certificate accepted; a client without ALPN is refused there
AWS-shaped endpoint: component -> dt/thing1/ and cloud -> component at QoS 1; the policy-denied subscription cmd/forbidden/# gets SUBACK 0x80, is reported, and the other subscriptions work
policy-denied publication: AWS-style disconnect on each of 3 attempts, then the message is rejected and counted (not retried forever) and the following telemetry is delivered
Device Shadow: a local report is pushed; a cloud desired change is pulled within seconds although the poll interval is 3600 s (update/documents notification) and announced as a local delta

outage: offline local and cloud shadow edits reconciled by three-way merge (desired.x -> cloud owner, reported.mode -> device owner, one-sided keys kept on both sides); 3 spooled publications delivered in order and a cloud command queued by the persistent session delivered after reconnect
version race: the device's update is refused with 409 after a concurrent cloud write; it re-reads, merges and stores, keeping both changes
deletion: a local deletion deletes the AWS shadow; a cloud recreation and a cloud deletion are pulled

identities: unknown CA (TLS refused), deactivated certificate (closed after handshake) and another thing's certificate (CONNACK 5, client id must be its thing) are each refused; publications wait in the spool and arrive in order once valid rotated credentials are installed (rogue-thing1: tls-refused; thing1a: certificate-not-active; thing2: connect-refused)
kill -9 during an outage: spooled publications delivered in order after restart; the persisted sync base means no redundant shadow writes
no private key material in the daemon log or state directory (bridge.json, spools, shadows)
unrun: Real AWS IoT Core endpoint, account policy and Device Shadow service; needs separate user authorization
